name: Dranik Heartlands: Ruins
summary: Ruined Dragorn settlements shattered by war and corrupted by Discord energy.
description: The Ruins are the remnants of Dragorn villages and ceremonial sites destroyed during the Muramite invasion. Crumbling stone, collapsed structures, and Discord‑warped rubble dominate the landscape. Muramite scavengers search the ruins for artifacts and survivors, while Dragorn resistance fighters use hidden tunnels to strike from the shadows. Discord anomalies flicker through broken walls, animating debris and warping the terrain. The Ruins represent the tragic heart of Dranik’s downfall.
